title: Tech Note: Web Storage
author: Rudolf Psenicnik, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: 4D replication via HTTP feeding browser-side offline storage
Cross-browser inspection of stored data (Chrome, Safari, Firefox)

historical_commentary.text: The HTML5 Web Storage API (localStorage/sessionStorage) described here is a web standard that is still fully supported by all modern browsers and remains a valid, current technique for client-side offline data persistence, independent of any 4D-specific product changes. The 4D-side replication-over-HTTP mechanism used to populate it, however, is dated compared to 4D's modern REST/ORDA-based data access, which would be the more idiomatic way to feed browser-side storage today.
related_updates: 4D REST APIs (via ORDA, from v16 R5/17+) are now a more modern way to fetch 4D data for client-side storage than the HTTP replication approach shown here
